en.title: Run CMSY++ for the Main Species of a Fishing Area
en.description:
This function does in one call what `cmsy_input()`, `cmsy_run()`, `cmsy_plot()`,
`cmsy_forecast()` and `cmsy_tables()` do step by step, for the species with the largest catch in
an FAO fishing area (or for chosen species): it prepares the catch-only input, runs CMSY++ on
every stock, draws the charts, projects the stocks under fishing scenarios and writes the
tables. Progress bars follow each step.
en.value:
Invisibly, the result of `cmsy_run()` with the elements `input`, `forecast`, `tables`
and `dir` (the folder of the area); a list of these, named by area, for several areas.

arguments.area:
FAO major fishing area name(s), as in `fishing_area_data()` (e.g.
"Atlantic, Eastern Central"), or FAO catch data such as `fishing_area_data()$area_data`.
arguments.top: Number of species with the largest catch to assess. Default is 10.
arguments.species:
Optional species to assess instead of the `top` ones, by English or Chinese
name, scientific name or FAO 3-alpha code.
arguments.recent_years:
Catch is ranked by its mean over the last `recent_years` years of the
data. Default is 10.
arguments.out_dir: The folder in which a folder per area is made. Default is "cmsy_areas".
arguments.auto_start:
As in `cmsy_run()`, but TRUE by default here: a stock whose start biomass is
ambiguous starts in the first year with at least 40% of the maximum catch, as suggested
by CMSY++.
arguments.seed: The random seed of the runs, so that the results can be repeated. Default is 1.
arguments.parallel:
The number of stocks run at the same time. Each uses two more processes for
its two MCMC chains. Default is half the number of processor cores.
arguments.settings:
Optional named list of CMSY++ settings that replace its defaults, e.g.
`list(CV.C = 0.2, n.iter = 100000, n.burnin = 50000)`. See `cmsy_defaults()` for the
settings, their defaults and what they do. Default is no change: CMSY++ runs with its own
defaults. The settings used are saved in `settings_used.csv` of the run folder and in
`result$settings`.
arguments.charts: The charts to draw (see `cmsy_plot()`). Default is all of them.
arguments.classes: The status classes: "fao" (default, two classes) or "palomares" (five classes).
arguments.forecast:
A logical value. If TRUE (default), the stocks are also projected under the
default fishing scenarios of `cmsy_forecast()`.
arguments.annotations:
The text added to the axis titles and labels: FALSE (default) none, TRUE
all, or any of "title", "subtitle", "caption", "legend" and "labels" (text inside the
chart). The default can be changed for the session with
`options(faofishingreport.cmsy_annotations = TRUE)`.
arguments.lang:
The language of the chart text and names: "en" (English), "zh" (Chinese) or
"both" (Chinese and English). Default is NULL, which uses the language set with
`fao_settings()` ("en" unless changed).
arguments.pptx:
A logical value. If TRUE, the charts are also saved as editable PowerPoint files in
`<out_dir>/<area>/figures_pptx/`. Default is FALSE, which can be changed for all functions
with `fao_settings(pptx = TRUE)`.
arguments.silent:
A logical value. If FALSE (default), a progress bar shows how many stocks have
finished, with the elapsed and the estimated remaining time, and messages report the
run. If TRUE, nothing is printed. The default can be changed for the session with
`fao_settings(silent = TRUE)`.

zh.title: 一次完成某个渔区主要物种的CMSY++评估
zh.description: 本函数一次完成`cmsy_input()`、`cmsy_run()`、`cmsy_plot()`、`cmsy_forecast()`和`cmsy_tables()`分步完成的工作，对象是某个FAO渔区中渔获量最大的物种（或指定的物种）：准备仅基于渔获量的输入数据，对每个种群运行CMSY++，绘制图表，预测各种群在不同捕捞情景下的变化，并写出表格。每一步都有进度条显示进度。
zh.details:
每个渔区的结果保存在各自的文件夹`out_dir/<area>/`中：

- **input/**：CMSY++的渔获量文件和ID文件、所用的种群，以及未纳入评估的主要物种及其原因（例如没有r先验：见`cmsy_input()`的`priors`和`default_resilience`）；
- **runs/**：每个种群的CMSY++运行结果（其文件夹中有CMSY++的原始图表、输出和日志）、修改后的CMSY++代码和修改清单；
- **figures/**：每个种群一个图表文件夹，另有一个包含全部种群的`summary/`文件夹（PNG格式；`pptx`为TRUE时，PowerPoint文件保存在`figures_pptx/`中）；
- **tables/**：结果、逐年序列、报告用的先验参数表和结果表、预测结果、所用的CMSY++设置（`settings_used.csv`）以及所用全部内容的来源（`sources.csv`）。

与`cmsy_input()`中一样，FAO数据只有渔获量（没有资源丰度指数），所以所有种群都只用CMSY++中仅基于渔获量的部分进行评估，结果仅具指示意义。
zh.value: 以不可见方式返回`cmsy_run()`的结果，并附加`input`、`forecast`、`tables`和`dir`（该渔区的文件夹）几个元素；有多个渔区时，返回由这些结果组成、以渔区命名的列表。

arguments.area: FAO主要渔区名称（可以是多个），写法与`fishing_area_data()`中相同（例如"Atlantic, Eastern Central"），也可以是FAO渔获量数据，例如`fishing_area_data()$area_data`。
arguments.top: 要评估的渔获量最大的物种数。默认为10。
arguments.species: 可选，指定要评估的物种，以代替渔获量最大的`top`个物种；可以用英文名或中文名、学名或FAO三字母代码给出。
arguments.recent_years: 按数据最后`recent_years`年的平均渔获量对物种排序。默认为10。
arguments.out_dir: 存放结果的文件夹，每个渔区在其中各建一个文件夹。默认为"cmsy_areas"。
arguments.auto_start: 同`cmsy_run()`，但这里默认为TRUE：起始生物量难以判断的种群，按CMSY++的建议从渔获量首次达到最大值至少40%的年份开始。
arguments.seed: 运行所用的随机数种子，使结果可以重复。默认为1。
arguments.parallel: 同时运行的种群数。每个种群还要为其两条MCMC链另外使用两个进程。默认为处理器物理核心数的一半。
arguments.settings: 可选，用于替换CMSY++默认值的CMSY++设置（命名列表），例如`list(CV.C = 0.2, n.iter = 100000, n.burnin = 50000)`。各项设置、默认值及其作用见`cmsy_defaults()`。默认不做更改：CMSY++使用自己的默认值运行。所用的设置保存在运行文件夹的`settings_used.csv`和`result$settings`中。
arguments.charts: 要绘制的图表（见`cmsy_plot()`）。默认为全部图表。
arguments.classes: 资源状态分类："fao"（默认，两类）或"palomares"（五类）。
arguments.forecast: 逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时，还按`cmsy_forecast()`的默认捕捞情景对各种群进行预测。
arguments.annotations: 在坐标轴标题和坐标轴标签之外添加到图表中的文字：FALSE（默认）不添加，TRUE全部添加，或从"title"（标题）、"subtitle"（副标题）、"caption"（图注）、"legend"（图例）和"labels"（图表内的文字）中任选。可以用`options(faofishingreport.cmsy_annotations = TRUE)`在本次R会话中更改默认值。
arguments.lang: 图表文字和名称的语言："en"（英文）、"zh"（中文）或"both"（中英双语）。默认为NULL，即使用`fao_settings()`设置的语言（未更改时为"en"）。
arguments.pptx: 逻辑值。为TRUE时，图表还另存为可编辑的PowerPoint文件，保存在`<out_dir>/<area>/figures_pptx/`中。默认为FALSE，可以用`fao_settings(pptx = TRUE)`为所有函数统一更改。
arguments.silent: 逻辑值。为FALSE（默认）时，用进度条显示已完成的种群数以及已用时间和预计剩余时间，并输出运行信息。为TRUE时不输出任何内容。可以用`fao_settings(silent = TRUE)`在本次R会话中更改默认值。
